findings.claim: The new branches that fail a memory with a non-numeric id when its page is unreadable (no own page, unreadable pages present) in both propagation walks have no test. The new test covers only the readable-page case, so a regression there would go unnoticed.

evidence: Both walks now return the numericID error through SyncFailure when the memory has a page, or an unreadable page that could be its own, and its id is not a number. That matches the claim in the commit message.
The ordering in propagate.go is unchanged: the styleOf failure is still reported before the id error. A memory with both problems is failed on the style, under id 0 (not a regression).

The test and doc edits (walk_failures_test.go, walk_bridged_test.go, source.go) change no production behaviour. I could not verify from the diff that the c-000900 page in the bridged fixture still matches cardMemory's address.
